content.Resumption of activities: Information on resumption of activities, sexual activity, and environmental factors is presented in the Supplementary data online, Section 13.1.2.

Pharmacological treatment.Antithrombotic therapy: Recommendations for antithrombotic therapy are included in Section 6.

Lipid-lowering therapy - summary.Overall: Dyslipidaemia should be managed according to current dyslipidaemia guidelines using lifestyle and pharmacological interventions. Lower LDL-C levels after ACS are associated with lower cardiovascular event rates.
LDL-C targets: Primary secondary-prevention target: LDL-C < 1.4 mmol/L (<55 mg/dL)
Aim for ≥50% LDL-C reduction from baseline
For patients with a second CV event within 2 years: LDL-C goal of <1.0 mmol/L (<40 mg/dL) may confer additional benefit
Lipid-lowering therapy - summary.Timing: Initiate lipid-lowering treatment as early as possible after an ACS event, preferably before planned PCI and during hospitalization to improve prognosis and adherence.
Lipid-lowering therapy - summary.Statin therapy: Recommend high-intensity statin (e.g., atorvastatin or rosuvastatin) initiated as early as possible and titrated to the highest tolerated dose; increase intensity if patient was on low- or moderate-intensity statin prior to ACS.
Lipid-lowering therapy - summary.Ezetimibe: In IMPROVE-IT, ezetimibe added early after ACS (within 10 days) to prior statin therapy or initiated concomitantly showed long-term cardiovascular benefit and is recommended if LDL-C targets are unlikely to be reached with statin alone.
Lipid-lowering therapy - summary.PCSK9 inhibitors: In the ODYSSEY OUTCOMES trial, treatment with the PCSK9 inhibitor alirocumab was initiated after ACS; PCSK9 inhibition is discussed as an option when LDL-C targets are not achieved with statin ± ezetimibe or in high-risk patients.
Clinical trials referenced: IMPROVE-IT (Vytorin Efficacy International Trial) - ezetimibe added to statin after ACS
ODYSSEY OUTCOMES - alirocumab (PCSK9 inhibitor) after ACS

content.Other recommendations: All patients should have mental well-being assessed using validated tools before discharge, with consideration of psychological referral when appropriate. For further details refer to 2021 ESC Guidelines on cardiovascular disease prevention.

genes.context: Mentioned as 'proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9) inhibitor alirocumab' in the context of the ODYSSEY OUTCOMES trial and as an option for lowering LDL-C after ACS.
